prompt:
Compound X has molecular formula C₄H₈O₂. Its IR spectrum shows a strong absorption at 1740 cm⁻¹ and no broad absorption above 2500 cm⁻¹. Its ¹H NMR spectrum has three signals: δ 4.1 (2H, quartet), δ 2.0 (3H, singlet), δ 1.3 (3H, triplet).

**(a)** Calculate the index of hydrogen deficiency. **[1]**

**(b)** Identify the functional group and explain the IR evidence. **[2]**

**(c)** Deduce the structure of X, explaining the NMR splitting. **[3]**
markscheme:
**(a)** $\tfrac{(10 - 8)}{2} = 1$ ✓

**(b)** Ester ✓; C=O at 1740 cm⁻¹ with no O–H absorption, so not an acid/alcohol ✓

**(c)** CH₃COOCH₂CH₃ (ethyl ethanoate) ✓; quartet (2H) and triplet (3H) show a CH₂CH₃ group, the CH₂ at 4.1 ppm bonded to O ✓; singlet (3H) at 2.0 ppm is CH₃ next to C=O with no neighbouring H ✓
